items.title: 68099_Erskine Hawkins oral history interview
items.q: I was in there just maybe, what, two months or something like that. That's about all. I got in because at the time, I can't think of his name, a trumpet player who was in the band. His name, he was the leader. Then, he finished, and then they made me the leader. Carl Thompson. That's the name.
